The orthorhombic crystal Ba2Mg3BiO6 (space group Amm2, No. 38) has 24 atoms per unit cell across eight independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Ba centers with 8 O neighbors and Bi centers with 5 O neighbors, while Mg adopts both tetrahedral and 5-vertex O-coordinated environments. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Mg tetrahedra, and corner-sharing between Ba and Mg polyhedra.
